"""Private 3sc installer pins; importing validates only, never launches apps."""
import json
import os
import re

OLD_COMMIT = "d00e4a3eb79400bf25ac1f6fe16b322666464415"
OLD_REVISION = "49261 +202 (Git)"
OLD_NATIVE_SHA256 = "54311d44545363ff17406531ca2b489364af77a14141d6addc305f226ea3611e"
NATIVE_CODE_ID = "09e5735a7733ce43e3d367b77d6c8be200d85319abb54defe12dbab3797f58c5"
ORDINARY_CCX_SHA256 = "b94868f6dd50533d7a8f11d271864a04bbf01f4117046d0c5b35e3cad470aac6"
COMMIT = os.environ["FREECAD_3SC_COMPILED_COMMIT"]
REVISION = os.environ["FREECAD_3SC_COMPILED_REVISION"]
assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", COMMIT) and COMMIT != OLD_COMMIT
assert re.fullmatch(r"\d+ \+\d+ \(Git\)", REVISION) and REVISION != OLD_REVISION
FEM_TEST_COUNT = int(os.environ["FREECAD_3SC_FEM_TEST_COUNT"])
FORCE_ACCOUNTING_TEST_COUNT = int(os.environ["FREECAD_3SC_FORCE_ACCOUNTING_TEST_COUNT"])
MATERIAL_APP_TEST_COUNT = int(os.environ["FREECAD_3SC_MATERIAL_APP_TEST_COUNT"])
MATERIAL_GUI_TEST_COUNT = int(os.environ["FREECAD_3SC_MATERIAL_GUI_TEST_COUNT"])
assert FEM_TEST_COUNT >= 315 and FORCE_ACCOUNTING_TEST_COUNT >= 14
assert MATERIAL_APP_TEST_COUNT >= 15 and MATERIAL_GUI_TEST_COUNT >= 3
REGRESSION_COUNTS = {
    "contact": 34,
    "material_groups": 12,
    "rigid_region_ownership": 15,
    "rigid_port_connector": 8,
    "force_accounting": FORCE_ACCOUNTING_TEST_COUNT,
}
if "FREECAD_3SC_REGRESSION_COUNTS" in os.environ:
    reviewed = json.loads(os.environ["FREECAD_3SC_REGRESSION_COUNTS"])
    assert set(reviewed) == set(REGRESSION_COUNTS)
    assert all(isinstance(value, int) and value > 0 for value in reviewed.values())
    assert reviewed["force_accounting"] == FORCE_ACCOUNTING_TEST_COUNT
    REGRESSION_COUNTS = reviewed
